crag.name: Panshamn
crag.access_info:
❗️IMPORTANT INFO❗️

🚫 By "Gränslandet" there are blocs very close to some houses (by the water) – do not climb on these!
🔫 During autumn there might be hunters in the area – be respectful and careful.
🤫 The blocs at "Gränslandet" are close to some houses – keep a low profile here!
🗑 Remove all of your trash!
🧹 Brush off tickmarks and excessive chalk!
🚜 Park so that large vehicles can pass by!

PARKING
• The Parkings are marked on the map.

APPROACH
• See the GPS trails on the map.

routes.name: Hammarhaj
routes.info: Start low with both hands on the sloper-shelf. • White #28b
